## Acceptance criteria

1. `onex-valkey-credentials` and `umami-credentials` Secrets exist in `onex-prod` on the public cluster (`i-<public-cluster-instance>`), sourced through the same `InfisicalSecret`/Infisical-operator path as the namespace's other secrets (no one-off manual `kubectl create secret`).
2. The 5 pods listed above reach `Running`/`Ready` without a manual pod restart being the only fix (i.e., the underlying secret-sync path is what's fixed, not just the symptom).
3. A note recorded on whether `omnidash` CrashLoopBackOff and `omniintelligence` Init:CrashLoopBackOff share this root cause or are separate.
